label: early original token (t=2-3) following a g/o/e context, current token in l/p/1/f/c/o/x/w/q/u/d/m
explanation: Sparse feature (about 0.07% of steps) that fires almost only in the original-input phase, mostly at t=2-3 (about 75% of mass), never at t=0-1, and almost never in the copy phase. It needs a context of g/o/e as the previous input (prev_tok g 15x lift, o 9x, e 4x) and e/g/2/o/u two steps back. Firing is also gated by the current token: l, p, 1, f, c, o, x, w, q are favored. The trigram conjunction gets dev F1 about 0.49 (precision 0.42, recall 0.58). The context-only versions are very imprecise (precision 0.03-0.2), so the current-token identity matters. The rest of the mass is a tail at later original positions (t=7-8) and at the delimiter step in long sequences, often after a g/e/o earlier in the sequence; the simple predicate does not capture it. The strongest activations come at the delimiter or a late token in sequences that contain e/g early on (for example m h h g e a h z l). I did not reduce magnitude to a clean rule.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & prev_tok=g (+4.19), orig1=e (+3.77), prev2_tok=g (+3.69), prev2_tok=2 (+3.45), prev_tok=o (+3.32), prev2_tok=o (+3.16). Lower it: phase=2 (-6.40), in_tok=e (-4.70), prev2_tok=- (-4.05), in_tok=g (-3.85).
